name: new_litigation_intake

Client requests immediate assessment and demand letter.

Demand letter drafted for MAT-102: Westfield Manufacturing Corp v. Pacific Supply Chain LLC. Letter demands cessation of competing product sales, cure within 30 days, and $2.3M in damages. Partner review scheduled.

Matter status report MAT-102: Intake complete, conflict check cleared, research memo filed, demand letter in partner review. Initial billing entry: 8.5 hours ($4,250). Next action: send demand letter upon partner approval.

retrieve EEOC complaint DOC-5510, federal complaint DOC-5511, and performance reviews DOC-5512 for matter MAT-103

litigation hold notice templates and client advisory memo formats for employment defense matters

name: contract_review_and_negotiation

trigger.description: Client requests review of proposed Master Services Agreement with enterprise software vendor. Contract value $1.8M over 3 years. Client is the customer. Key concerns: data security provisions, liability caps, termination rights, and IP ownership of customizations. Turnaround requested within 5 business days.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: intake and conflict check, analyze contract clauses and risks, prepare redline for client review and signing, generate client memo with recommendations and billing entry.

reads.query: search client database for Redwood Financial Group (CLT-031) and NovaTech Software Inc for conflict check
retrieve draft MSA DOC-5520, vendor security certification DOC-5521, and prior vendor agreement DOC-5522 for matter MAT-104
standard MSA clause analysis including data security provisions, liability caps, termination rights, and IP ownership for SaaS agreements
market-standard terms for enterprise software MSAs valued at $1.5-2M and customer-favorable redline positions
contract redline tracking procedures and client review workflow for transactional matters
prior MSA reviews for CLT-031 and standard billing practices for contract review engagements

writes.content: Conflict check completed for MAT-104: No conflicts. Redwood Financial Group (CLT-031) confirmed as client. NovaTech Software Inc not a current client. Engagement confirmed for contract review scope.

Contract analysis memo MAT-104: MSA review complete. Key issues identified: (1) liability cap at 12-month fees is below market, recommend 24-month; (2) data security provisions lack breach notification timeline; (3) IP ownership of customizations ambiguous; (4) termination for convenience requires 180-day notice, recommend 90-day.

Redline prepared for MAT-104: 23 markup items across data security (7), liability (4), IP ownership (5), termination (3), and general terms (4). Client memo with priority recommendations attached. Awaiting client review.

Matter status report MAT-104: MSA redline delivered to client within 5-day turnaround. 23 proposed changes with risk-ranked recommendations. Billing entry: 6.8 hours ($3,400). Next action: incorporate client feedback and negotiate with counterparty.

name: settlement_negotiation_and_closure

trigger.description: Opposing counsel in Henderson v. GreenLeaf Property Management (slip and fall, torn rotator cuff) has made a settlement offer of $185,000. Client's medical bills total $62,000. Lost wages $28,000. Treating physician projects 6 months additional physical therapy. Need to evaluate offer against likely trial outcome and advise client.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: review docket status and deadlines, research comparable verdicts and settlements, process settlement payment through trust account if accepted, generate closing memo to client, final invoice, and matter closure.

reads.query: retrieve matter MAT-087 docket status, pending deadlines, and case timeline for Henderson v. GreenLeaf Property Management
retrieve settlement offer DOC-5530, medical records DOC-5531, and demand letter DOC-5532 for settlement evaluation
comparable slip-and-fall verdicts and settlements for rotator cuff injuries with similar medical specials ($62,000) and lost wages ($28,000)
settlement multiplier analysis for personal injury cases with ongoing PT needs and jurisdiction-specific verdict trends
trust account procedures for settlement disbursement and matter closure checklist
final billing reconciliation and client closing memo templates for settled personal injury cases

writes.content: Settlement evaluation MAT-087: $185,000 offer analyzed. Medical specials $62,000, lost wages $28,000, projected future PT $15,000. Total specials $105,000. Offer represents 1.76x multiplier. Comparable cases settle at 2.0-2.5x. Recommendation: counter at $235,000.

Settlement research memo MAT-087: Comparable verdicts in jurisdiction range $150,000-$310,000 for slip-and-fall rotator cuff injuries. Median settlement $205,000. Trial risk factors: comparative negligence defense, strong liability facts for plaintiff.

Settlement processing MAT-087: Client advised of offer analysis and counter-recommendation. If settlement accepted, trust account disbursement prepared: attorney fees (33.3%), medical liens, costs, net to client.

Matter status report MAT-087: Settlement offer $185,000 under evaluation. Counter-offer recommendation at $235,000 based on comparable analysis. Client consultation scheduled. Billing to date: 42.5 hours ($21,250).
